The shock absorbers vary in condition: some show rust, paint chipping, and signs of wear; some have purple paint marks on the top mounts.
No visible branding or model tags are readable on any of the shock absorbers in either photo.

The seller claims compatibility with Volkswagen Passat CC, TSI, FSI, Tiguan, and Jetta 6, but no visual evidence confirms this.
